amendments: 1.1: Added a native main-effects EBM baseline before final-test access; no split, seed, target, feature window, operating policy, or test data changed.

1.2: Before final-test access, froze semantic-group SHAP aggregation, label-free case selection, perturbation scaling, capacity-consistent recourse, subgroup suppression, proxy diagnostics, paired uncertainty, and no-feedback human-study rules.

1.3: Before final-test access, made explicit that the 20 faithfulness/stability audit cases come from the validation split (predictions only), added an optional exploratory plain-language narrative condition for the explanation group (at least 12 participants), and specified precomputed-output interface rules; no model, split, seed, target, feature window, operating policy, or test data changed.

ebm.categorical_representation: explicit nominal feature types on raw named columns
ebm.explanation: exact additive global shape functions and local term contributions

operating_policy.counterfactual_success: case leaves the flagged top-20% set after its score is changed, all other cohort scores are held fixed, and ranking is recomputed

shap.semantic_group_aggregation: sum signed member SHAP values, then rank groups by the absolute signed total

faithfulness.case_selection: four deterministic positions from each of five predicted-risk strata; predictions only, labels unused
faithfulness.primary_statistic: area between ranked and random cumulative absolute probability-change curves
faithfulness.masking: training median/mode with semantic grouping and derived-feature recomputation

stability.continuous_perturbation_scale: Gaussian SD equals 1% of the feature's training-set SD; clip to training range and recompute derived features

fairness.small_group_policy: retain every group count in the table, suppress performance metrics when n < 30, and state when comparison is unavailable
fairness.proxy_association_scope: all non-protected model features against every protected attribute; Cramer's V for categorical features and correlation ratio eta for continuous features

calibration.probabilities: raw frozen-model outputs; no post-test recalibration
calibration.interface_label: estimated model risk, not a causal or guaranteed individual probability

human_study.scored_case_selection: five flagged and five unflagged cases selected deterministically across each output group's risk range; model predictions only, outcome labels unused
human_study.answer_feedback: none until all 10 scored cases are submitted

optional_narrative_condition.design: explanation group split into contribution chart only and chart plus plain-language narrative rendered by a verified local template from the same contributions; no free-form generated text
optional_narrative_condition.status: exploratory, reported separately from model results

interface.outputs: versioned precomputed Python outputs; no live inference
interface.study_cases_loaded: after the single final evaluation, followed by an export-parity check without retuning
interface.invalid_fields: reject missing, extra, invalid or out-of-range fields; never silently change them

test_access: locked until this protocol and all integration checks pass
